company.name: Triomics
company.shortDescription: Triomics is a generative AI-powered platform that matches patients to clinical trials.
company.description: Triomics is a generative AI-powered platform that matches patients to clinical trials. The company advances oncology research and care operations by aiding in accelerating trial enrollment, quality improvement projects, and streamlining healthcare operations, among other functions. It's trusted and validated foundational oncology AI, trained to comprehend health records and medical terminology, underpins this critical mission.

productsAndServices.description: An oncology-focused AI platform that converts longitudinal EHR data into structured, cited outputs for clinical trial matching, visit preparation, registry curation, and research workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Triomics Oncology AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI clinical trial-matching and screening product that evaluates oncology patients against active studies, provides cited eligibility evidence, and continuously updates matches as patient records change.
productsAndServices.name: PRISM

productsAndServices.description: An AI assistant for oncology visit preparation that summarizes longitudinal records, drafts pre-charting notes, answers chart-based questions, and extracts clinical details into structured fields within the EHR.
productsAndServices.name: Symphony

productsAndServices.description: An AI data-curation product that converts unstructured oncology records into cited, structured data for tumor registries, quality reporting, observational research, and real-world evidence programs.
productsAndServices.name: Harmony

productsAndServices.description: Clinical development services for oncology sponsors that use site-deployed patient data to accelerate enrollment, measure screening funnels, assess feasibility, and improve trial protocol design.
productsAndServices.name: Life Sciences Clinical Development Solutions

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,076,369 to $145,201,925, a 69.93x increase.
